memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: The descendants of Issachar by their clans were... those numbered were 64,300. The descendants of Zebulun by their clans were... those numbered were 60,500. The descendants of Joseph by their clans through Manasseh and Ephraim were as follows... - Num 26:23-37 (NIV, abridged)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The counting continues through Issachar, Zebulun, and the sons of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim. Tribe after tribe is numbered, each taking its place in the whole. No tribe is left out or forgotten. Together they formed the one people of God, each with its own portion in the community and its own share in the promise.

There is beauty in this completeness. God's people were not a shapeless mass but an ordered whole, made up of distinct tribes and families, each with its place. Every part belonged. The larger tribes and the smaller ones alike were counted as members of the one covenant nation.

This pictures something true of God's people in every age. We are many and varied, yet we belong together as one. No one is unimportant; no one is left out. Each has a place and a part to play in the community God is building. The Lord values both the prominent and the obscure among His people.

In Christ, this finds its fullest expression. Believers are joined together as one body, with many members, each needed and each belonging (1 Cor 12:12). You are not meant to stand alone but to take your place among God's people. Just as every tribe was counted here, you are counted in, a valued part of the family of God.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you know your place among God's people?
2. How does belonging to the whole community strengthen your faith?
3. What part might God be calling you to play in His family?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that in Christ I belong to Your people, counted in and valued. Help me take my place among Your family and serve faithfully as a member of Your body. Amen.
